## Summary

Describe the dataset, documentation, or explorer change.

## Provenance

Explain where new records or claims came from. Do not include private logs, customer conversations, or personal data.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Labels and splits remain intentional.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under CC BY 4.0.
